label: MP-6(2)
title: Equipment Testing

statement.prose: Test sanitization equipment and procedures {{ insert: param, mp-6.2_prm_1 }} to ensure that the intended sanitization is being achieved.

guidance: Testing of sanitization equipment and procedures may be conducted by qualified and authorized external entities, including federal agencies or external service providers.

guidelines: frequency with which to test sanitization equipment is defined;
